answer: Require each identity to post a refundable bond locked for one epoch, with slashing only after independent proof of duplicate control. Randomly sample unrelated reviewers to audit links. An attacker must lock one bond per identity and risks losing each bond, so capital tied up and expected losses rise linearly with the Sybil count; recruiting colluders adds coordination expense. The challenge words fable knoll velvet identify the prompt, not unique people.
